name: com.uavforecast/uav-forecast
title: UAV Forecast
description: Drone flying conditions checked against your own UAV Forecast settings: verdicts, wind, Kp.

tools.name: check_good_to_fly
tools.description: Answers: can I fly my drone now, when today or this week, where (compare up to 5 places), which day is best, and why not. Judges every hour against the user's own thresholds, flying hours and profile, and returns good windows, the runs of hours that fail and why, per-day summaries for longer ranges, and weather warnings in effect. "Good" means within the user's own UAV Forecast limits, not safe; airspace, permissions, aircraft limits and battery are not included. Current factor keys: wind_at_altitude, max_altitude, temp_or_wind_chill, humidity, delta_t, precip_prob, precip_intensity, thunder_prob, cloud_cover, cloud_base, icing, visibility, sun_elevation, gps, kp, gps_kp, gust_at_altitude; unknown keys may appear. Current notice kinds: weather_alert; more kinds may appear. Anything the plan, region or data sources don't include is listed under "unavailable" with a reason (plan, region, source, setting).

items.description: A favorite location's name, a place name, "lat, lon" coordinates, or "here".

places.description: Favorite location names, place names, coordinates, or "here".

start.description: Local date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date-time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM) at the place.

end.description: Local date or date-time; exclusive for a date-time, inclusive for a date.

days.description: From now to local midnight after this many days (1 = the rest of today). Not with start/end or hours.

hours.description: From now for this many hours. Not with start/end or days.

profile.description: A saved settings profile's name, to answer with that profile's settings instead of the current ones.

tools.name: get_hourly_forecast
tools.description: Answers: what will the wind, gusts, temperature, rain, cloud and other conditions be at a place and time, including wind and gusts at chosen heights above ground, and what were they in past hours the plan includes. Returns hourly values in the user's units, each with its status against the user's thresholds. "Good" means within the user's own UAV Forecast limits, not safe; airspace, permissions, aircraft limits and battery are not included. Current factor keys: wind_at_altitude, max_altitude, temp_or_wind_chill, humidity, delta_t, precip_prob, precip_intensity, thunder_prob, cloud_cover, cloud_base, icing, visibility, sun_elevation, gps, kp, gps_kp, gust_at_altitude; unknown keys may appear. Anything the plan, region or data sources don't include is listed under "unavailable" with a reason (plan, region, source, setting).

place.description: A favorite location's name, a place name, "lat, lon" coordinates, or "here".

start.description: Local date or date-time; may be in the past within your plan's historical window.

factors.description: The factors to read; without it, those with an enabled threshold plus wind and gust.

altitudes.description: Heights above ground (AGL) in altitude_units; without altitude_units, the user's altitude units (see get_my_settings). Each must be above 0: the lowest forecast wind is the surface wind at 10 m (33 ft), so ask for that for wind at ground level.

altitude_units.description: m or ft; set it whenever the user names a unit.

profile.description: A saved settings profile's name, to answer with that profile's settings instead of the current ones.

tools.name: get_space_weather
tools.description: Answers: what is the Kp index now and over the next 3 days, is a geomagnetic storm expected, and will GPS be affected by the user's Kp threshold. Uses the Kp source the user's app uses, and labels every value with its source. Anything the plan, region or data sources don't include is listed under "unavailable" with a reason (plan, region, source, setting).

place.description: A favorite location's name, a place name, "lat, lon" coordinates, or "here". Times are then local there.

tools.name: get_my_settings
tools.description: Answers: what are my limits and units, what does my plan include, which profiles and favorite locations do I have, and why did a verdict come out as it did. Favorite locations are listed by name only. Current factor keys: wind_at_altitude, max_altitude, temp_or_wind_chill, humidity, delta_t, precip_prob, precip_intensity, thunder_prob, cloud_cover, cloud_base, icing, visibility, sun_elevation, gps, kp, gps_kp, gust_at_altitude; unknown keys may appear.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Answers: which place is meant when a name is ambiguous, such as several towns with the same name. The user's favorite locations whose names match come first. Optionally ranks the other results near another place or "here".

query.description: A place name, or part of one.

near.description: A place name or "here" to rank results near.
